about: Mutants of compiler/check/facts, the self-hosted checker's refinement facts (S3-FACTS). The laws beside the span arithmetic kill its mutants; the agreement with the Go checker (TestCompilerRefinementsAgreeWithChecker: corpus, seeded predicates and the odd declarations) kills the deciding and the diagnostics.

mutants.name: facts-dec-zero
mutants.rule: One below zero is -1: Dec crosses zero.

mutants.name: facts-compare-negatives
mutants.rule: Of two negative values the one of the larger magnitude is the lesser.

mutants.name: facts-union-adjacent
mutants.rule: A union merges adjacent spans: its spans are not adjacent (the normal form holds the same values either way, so only the normal form's law sees it).

mutants.name: facts-complement-drops-top
mutants.rule: A complement reaches the domain's greatest value.

mutants.name: facts-digit-value
mutants.rule: A decimal digit is its value: 9 reads as 9.

mutants.name: facts-refined-before-forgotten
mutants.rule: A where over a type refined by an earlier declaration is refused: write one where that holds both.

mutants.name: facts-law-param-where-refused
mutants.rule: A where on a law's parameter stands; on any other parameter it is S108.

mutants.name: facts-pattern-subject-unchecked
mutants.rule: A pattern's first argument is the subject it.

mutants.name: facts-outside-at-comparison
mutants.rule: A comparison whose other side is no integer literal is refused at that side, not at the comparison.

mutants.name: facts-empty-where-given
mutants.rule: A where no value satisfies is S108 and gives no refinement.

mutants.name: facts-admission-refined
mutants.rule: A law parameter's where that names an earlier parameter is an admission, not a refinement: no S108 (types.md, Laws 15).
